model.name: LTX-2.3 Dev FP8 22B (Quality Experimental)
model.description: Experimental quality profile using the official Lightricks FP8 mixed-precision LTX-2.3 dev checkpoint (22B), 30-step CFG pipeline, and distilled refiner LoRA. It is not a speed peer of Distilled and requires a conservative low-RAM offload profile on a 64 GB host.
